tips.before_install:
Immich needs a system with at least 6GB of RAM and 2 CPU cores
(Immich's own requirement). Machine learning and the first
library import are heavy, so expect high CPU use at first.

Always follow a 3-2-1 backup plan for your precious photos and
videos. Immich is not a backup by itself.

First start: open http://<zima-ip>:2283 and create the admin
account. For the mobile apps, use that address as the Server
Endpoint URL.

Storage: uploads go to /DATA/Gallery/immich. The Postgres
database and the machine learning model cache live in this app's
AppData folder. Keep the database on local storage, not a network
share, as Immich requires.

Database password: the bundled database is not published outside
this app, so it uses Immich's example password. Do not change
DB_PASSWORD after the first start; Postgres stores it in its data
folder and the server would no longer be able to connect.

Ports: 2283 must be free. If you installed another Immich from a
different store, remove it or change its port first.

title: Immich
